overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to answer a minutes request and an OML complaint; the minutes violation was intentional, but no monetary penalty was imposed, only training and compliance orders.

allegations.summary: Commission did not respond within 10 days to an October 2017 request to review open and executive session minutes for 2015 to 2017.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Commission did not respond to the October 12, 2017 request within ten days, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Commission did not respond within 14 business days to an Open Meeting Law complaint filed in October 2017.
allegations.key_passage: This failure to respond to an Open Meeting Law complaint within fourteen business days violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, review the Attorney General's training video on Meeting Minutes and notify the AG's office of compliance in writing.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements for responding to complaints.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
